title: Synthetic data
request: Some users cannot share data for confidentiality; they want to simulate it from a prompt, without any sample. The rows must stay labelled synthetic everywhere.
spec: draft/synthetic.py: a validated schema (from a model, or a built-in template the user picks), seeded generation, the label 'synthetic' kept from the draft to the exports. Done when tests/test_draft_synthetic.py passes and make product-e2e passes synthetic.
plan: Write a pydantic SyntheticSpec (columns with types and distributions, a target with a type, a rate and effects) that rejects unknown fields.
Write generate(spec) with a seed and a row cap, and five templates (churn, fraud at 0.5%, demand as time-ordered regression, credit, maintenance).
With a model, design the spec from the description as JSON; validate, retry once with the error, then fall back to a template.
Send the model the problem and the answers only, never data.
Store the asset with synthetic true, its spec and its outcome column, and label it in the project, the notebook, the report and the brief.

decisions.decision: A binary target's rate is calibrated exactly: a logistic latent score and the top round(rows x rate) rows positive, at least one positive.
decisions.why: Bernoulli draws after bisection can miss the asked rate by a point on small tables; the exact count keeps the same logistic model.

decisions.decision: Missing values are applied after the target is drawn, completely at random with an exact count.
decisions.why: The target reflects the true values, so missingness does not secretly carry signal.

decisions.decision: Effects on identifier, text and datetime columns are refused.
decisions.why: They would plant signals no real dataset carries in that form.

decisions.decision: The context sent to the model drops lists of objects, frames, arrays and keys like rows, sample, preview and data, and is capped at 4,000 characters.
decisions.why: The model designs a table from the description and must never receive data rows.

change: dclab_rnd/draft/synthetic.py (specs, generate, describe, save with the synthetic flag in the Parquet metadata, templates, spec_from_model with retry and fallback) and the synthetic routes; tests/test_draft_synthetic.py (29 tests).

findings.defect: Without a model, a template was picked silently from keywords and the rows did not follow the description.
findings.scenario: With no model configured, the template was chosen by counting keyword hits in the description, defaulting to churn; a description that matched no keyword got churn rows, and nothing on screen said the rows came from a template rather than from the description.
findings.fix: The Synthetic tabs list the built-in templates to pick from, the template is picked from the description and the problem sentence together, and the chat and the wizard say when rows come from a template and do not follow the description; the generator's own outcome column is offered first.

findings.defect: The exported notebook and report did not say the data was synthetic.
findings.scenario: A project built from simulated rows showed a 'synthetic' note in the brief, but the downloaded notebook and report presented their scores with no such note.
findings.cause: The label was carried to the brief only.
findings.fix: The notebook and the report open with the same note as the brief, because their scores say nothing about real cases.

measurements.name: synthetic flow
measurements.gate: make product-e2e passes the synthetic flow: one prompt to a completed run of all five stages, labelled synthetic.
measurements.result: Passed without a model; a synthetic regression table split by time with 5 folds completed all five stages.

outcome: Done: simulated data from a model's validated design or a chosen template, seeded, and labelled synthetic from the draft to every export.
lessons: A fallback that changes what the user gets must say so on screen.
Carry a 'this is not real data' label through every artefact, not only the main page.
